patterns.reminder: This looks like a real credential. Load it from the environment or the secret manager; never inline it.
Dynamic code execution. Use a parameterized alternative, or justify in a comment why this input can never be attacker-controlled.
DOM injection sink. Sanitize with the project's sanitizer or render as text.
Unsafe deserialization. Use a safe loader.
Possible credential in a log statement. Redact before logging.
CI workflow change. Confirm this does not add permissions, secrets access, or a new third-party action.
